name: Exploration / Collectathon
description: The wander-and-complete genre: a world dense with shinies, secrets, and traversal puzzles, where the scoreboard is a completion percentage. This pack layers completion accounting, secret discovery, guided hinting, grapple traversal, and photo mode over the existing platformer kit — the movement verbs stay generic so the same pack can dress a voxel island or an isometric diorama. The design stance: every collectible is found by looking, movement is the puzzle, and the hunt ends in a fanfare the player earned, not a waypoint the game surrendered.
loop: wander → spot shiny → reach it (movement puzzle) → completion %

signatureCompound.name: Hundred Percent Run
signatureCompound.description: The loop-proof compound: the scatter layer (Squad A's world.collectible_scatter) fills regions, completion_tracker counts them per region, hidden_alcove fires one-shot discovery fanfares that also feed the count, guided_hint_system reads the same ledger to rescue stalled hunts without stealing discoveries, and grapple_traversal plus the jump kit make 'reach it' the actual game. A 100% run is complete when progression.runCompleted fires.
